name: heapso
description: Find, draft, save and update your Heapso lesson plans, units and worksheets, and look up NCEA standards, from your AI.

interface.longDescription:
Heapso is a planning tool for teachers, made in New Zealand. Connect it to bring your Heapso plans into ChatGPT.

Search your lessons, units, worksheets, slide decks and week planners; open one to summarise or adapt it; draft a new plan in Heapso's format and save it to your account once you've checked it; or update a plan after you've approved the change. Earlier versions are kept.

Planning for NCEA? Look up achievement and unit standards by subject, level (Level 1, 2 or 3) and internal or external assessment, with links to each standard on the NZQA website, then turn a standard into a unit, lesson or revision worksheet and save it to Heapso. You can also check the learning areas, strands and phases of Te Mātaiaho, the New Zealand Curriculum, with links to Tāhūrangi. Heapso isn't part of NZQA or the Ministry of Education.

Also reads the class timetable you've imported into Heapso, and gives dated guidance on which New Zealand qualification (NCEA, NZCE or NZACE) a senior cohort will sit.

You need a Heapso account. Plans saved from ChatGPT are private to you. Heapso can't delete, share or publish plans from ChatGPT, and can't see billing, school administration or student records. For teachers, not students.

Plan your week from your timetable and existing units, adapt a lesson or worksheet for your class, continue a unit using your classroom feedback, or turn a lesson into a worksheet, slides and an exit ticket. Choose an anonymised class profile to supply class-level learning needs, without student records. Preview the complete draft before approving a save. An existing planner week is replaced only when explicitly reviewed; other resources are new private copies.
defaultPrompt: Use Heapso to plan my next teaching week from my timetable and units. Show me the week before saving.
Use Heapso to adapt my latest lesson for my class, then help me plan what to teach next based on my feedback.
Use Heapso to make a worksheet, slides and exit ticket from my lesson. Show all three before saving.

positive.prompt: Use Heapso to plan my teaching week from my timetable and units. Preview before saving.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms Monday and actual teaching progress, preserves existing notes/periods, previews the complete week, explicitly approves replacement when applicable, and returns the planner link after saving.

positive.prompt: Adapt my latest lesson for readers who need shorter instructions and give confident learners more depth.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms source and class needs without student identities; shows support, extension and accessibility changes; saves a private copy only after approval.

positive.prompt: Build the next lesson in my fractions unit. Most can model halves but need help comparing unlike denominators.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms what was taught, uses anonymised feedback in the next lesson, checks timings, previews and saves after approval without marking unit progress.

positive.prompt: Make a worksheet, slide deck and exit ticket from my fractions lesson. Show all three before saving.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows coherent resources and separate teacher answers, asks approval, atomically saves three private items and returns three working links.

positive.prompt: Use Heapso to check the Level 1 maths standard for my lesson before adapting it.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses verified standard codes and links to NZQA; does not invent equivalences.

negative.description: Deletion is unsupported. Explain the limit without calling a write tool.
Student records are outside connector access. Explain the limit without fetching student data.
negative.prompt: Show me named students' diagnoses and grades from Heapso.

negative.description: Billing is unsupported. Do not invoke tools or start a purchase.
negative.prompt: Upgrade my Heapso account to Pro and charge my card.

review.commerce_description: Heapso's tools don't sell anything, show prices or start payments.

publication.release_notes: Plan a week, adapt a class resource, build the next lesson and create a teaching pack with complete previews, approved saves and safe retries. Improved classroom-ready content checks and useful follow-up prompts.
